archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Technical Worksheet / Engineering Precision)

brand_identity.name: CIRCUIT-CRAFT
brand_identity.description: High-precision combination circuit trainer and interactive worksheet generator for electrical apprentices and engineering students.

entry_surfaces./: single-screen technical worksheet workbench — top utility header, split schematic + formula card, matrix answer grid below, interactive verification bar

mobile_first_design.viewport_rules: Touch-friendly input cells with minimum height 44px, numeric keypads enabled via inputMode='decimal', horizontal scroll indicators on matrix table for narrow screens, and responsive SVG scaling.
mobile_first_design.locale_conventions: Standard North American electrical notation (IEEE/ANSI zigzag resistors, E for electromotive force / volts, I for amperage, R for ohms, W/P for watts, ±1% tolerance).

layout_and_grid.structure: Single-page responsive engineering worksheet layout with maximum width of 1100px (max-w-5xl) centered on page.

sections.description: Clean technical blueprint header with Worksheet # badge, difficulty/preset selector, 'New Puzzle' CTA, 'Reset/Clear' CTA, and Print button.

Top section: High-contrast vector SVG schematic diagram (width 100%, aspect 16:9 or 2:1) showing DC source (E), series resistor R1, parallel split into branch A (R2 + R3 in series) and branch B (R4), with standard IEEE zigzag/IEC box resistors, polarity markings, junction dots, and given values clearly labeled.

Standard Electrician VIRP / EIRW matrix table. 5 rows (R1, R2, R3, R4, Total/Circuit) × 4 columns (Voltage E [V], Current I [A], Resistance R [Ω], Power P/W [W]). Pre-fills known given values in locked badge-styled cells and renders clean numeric input boxes for unknown learner entries.
Action bar containing 'Check Answers' (primary trigger), 'Reveal Worked Solution' (toggle step-by-step math panel), tolerance status (±1% tolerance applied), and score summary.

Collapsible step-by-step calculation card showing: Step 1 (Branch 1 series R23), Step 2 (Parallel equivalence R234), Step 3 (Total resistance R_total), Step 4 (Total current I_total), Step 5 (Voltages & Branch currents), Step 6 (Power calculations), with exact Ohm's Law and Joule's Law equations.

circuit_generation_logic.topology: Combination circuit: E source in series with R1, connected to parallel bank (Branch 1: R2 + R3 in series; Branch 2: R4).

nice_number_generator.rules: Generate clean integer or clean terminating decimal solutions. Predefined seed combinations or integer-ratio generators.

interactive_components.name: SchematicDiagram
interactive_components.props: { circuitData: CircuitValues, isRevealed: boolean, highlightElement?: string }

interactive_components.name: AnswerMatrixTable
interactive_components.props: { circuitData: CircuitValues, answers: UserAnswers, onAnswerChange: (elem: string, col: string, val: string) => void, validationState: ValidationResult | null, isRevealed: boolean }

interactive_components.name: WorkedSolution
interactive_components.props: { circuitData: CircuitValues, solution: StepByStepSolution, isOpen: boolean, onToggle: () => void }

motion_and_microinteractions.hover_effects: Buttons scale-98 on tap, smooth border transition on inputs (duration-150 ease-out).
motion_and_microinteractions.validation_animation: Green pulse / red shake micro-cue on inputs when 'Check Answers' is clicked.
motion_and_microinteractions.solution_drawer: Smooth height expansion using Tailwind transition or motion/react AnimatePresence.

accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: Matrix input cells must support standard Tab / Arrow navigation across columns and rows for lightning-fast worksheet completion.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep everything in a crisp, clean single-page layout matching an electrician certification exam worksheet.
2. Render an authentic, high-quality SVG schematic with clear labels for Source (E), R1 (series), Node A, Branch 1 (R2+R3), Branch 2 (R4), and Node B.
3. Provide realistic random circuit generator with known values: E_total and all four resistors R1, R2, R3, R4.
4. In the Answer Table, prefill given values (marked as readonly with 'Given' badge) and leave all other E, I, R, W cells as editable inputs.

5. When 'Check Answers' is clicked, compare each entered value against the calculated ground truth using ±1% tolerance or exact rounding to 2-3 decimal places. Display green checkmarks for correct entries and red highlights for incorrect entries, along with total accuracy score.

6. Include 'Reveal Solution' button with collapsible comprehensive step-by-step working: R23 series calculation, R_parallel calculation, R_total, I_total, V_drop across R1, V_parallel, branch currents, individual powers, and total power verification (P_total = E * I_total = sum of P_n).
7. Add a print stylesheet so users can click 'Print' or Ctrl+P to get a pristine physical paper worksheet.
8. Implement in frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx and modular components under frontend/src/components/circuit/.
